description: List the outbound network connections a sandbox made (newest first) — host, verdict (allowed/blocked), bytes, and credential-injected requests. Use it to audit what a sandbox actually reached and to verify allow_out/deny_out rules. When has_more is true, pass next_cursor as before to fetch the next page. Read-only — does not resume a paused sandbox.

before.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's next_cursor, or an RFC3339 timestamp to return older events.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 50, capped at 200).

verdict.description: Filter to connections with this verdict.

name: sandbox_network_log
title: Audit a sandbox's egress
